Polearmbreaker

A common metal used in crafting and construction. Strong, reliable, and easy to work with, it’s the foundation for basic weapons, armor, and tools. Often refined into stronger materials or used as a core crafting resource.
A refined metal made from iron and carbon. Stronger and more durable than iron, it’s commonly used for quality weapons, armor, and reinforced structures. A dependable mid-tier crafting material.

A rare, lustrous metal valued for both craft and ritual use. Less durable than steel but highly effective against certain creatures and magical threats. Commonly used in specialized weapons, charms, and currency.
A basic natural resource gathered from trees. Used for crafting tools, weapons, structures, and fuel. Common and easy to obtain.
